name: Slack

tiers.how: Sage connects to Slack via the official Slack Web API using a Bot Token (OAuth 2.0). The owner must create a Slack App at api.slack.com, add the required scopes (channels:history, chat:write, im:write), install the app to the workspace, and store the Bot Token via setup_creds. Event subscriptions require a public HTTPS endpoint for the request URL.
reads: messages in channels and DMs the bot is invited to
writes: messages to channels or DMs the bot is a member of
always_tap: any message posted to a client-facing or external channel
any direct message to a client or external party

gotchas: Bot tokens require workspace re-authorization (app reinstall) if scopes change after initial installation.
Slack's free plan limits message history to 90 days; older messages are inaccessible via the API.
Event subscriptions for incoming messages require a publicly reachable HTTPS endpoint; use Tailscale Funnel or a VPS.
Rate limits vary by API method tier; implement burst-safe retry with exponential backoff.
notes: Slack is an internal team communication tool; Sage uses it for team coordination and does not send client-facing messages through it.
